keyEvents.text: Shiloh 't Zand (Fortuna Sittard) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Go Ahead Eagles 0, Fortuna Sittard 0.
Substitution, Fortuna Sittard. Siebe Wylin replaces Ivo Pinto.
Substitution, Fortuna Sittard. Kristoffer Peterson replaces Sven Simons.
Goal! Go Ahead Eagles 0, Fortuna Sittard 1. Anthony Descotte (Fortuna Sittard) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Kristoffer Peterson.
Substitution, Go Ahead Eagles. Oskar Sivertsen replaces Alfons Sampsted.
Substitution, Fortuna Sittard. Iván Márquez replaces Shiloh 't Zand.
Joris Kramer (Go Ahead Eagles) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Go Ahead Eagles. Tomas Galvez replaces Thibo Baeten.
Substitution, Go Ahead Eagles. Robbin Weijenberg replaces Julius Dirksen.
Substitution, Go Ahead Eagles. Erik Flataker replaces Stefán Sigurdarson.
Mohamed Ihattaren (Fortuna Sittard) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Go Ahead Eagles. Gerrit Nauber replaces Mathis Suray.
Substitution, Fortuna Sittard. Nick de Groot replaces Jasper Dahlhaus.
Gerrit Nauber (Go Ahead Eagles) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Go Ahead Eagles 0, Fortuna Sittard 1.
